purpose: Repeat the fixed six-case readiness once with the V9 online observation operator made identical to its frozen training operator.

approval.scope: All in-scope implementation choices and the one immutable V1R3 six-case formal run without repeated approval.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly requested that the agent choose the optimal in-scope path and stop asking for repeated approvals.

raw_sources: Sealed V9 ROS deployment export with three frozen checkpoints and seal SHA-256 a99ea047246643ed7293dc2fe0d40406a528cc0e0b15b5167307ab70697b3205.
AEE tunnel and garage development worlds in the frozen planner-seed-v1-runnable image.
Frozen organized /velodyne_points physical-beam operator used by the approved 1000-frame AEE corrective dataset.

Sealed V1R2 run with one 180-second case whose learned-empty rate was 814/901 under the incompatible registered-point rerasterizer; seal SHA-256 86f16767b769fdb9a72d8328f8b4a03641e950331d1eb740e99411f77ed60b42.
Read-only 1000-frame AEE audit where every V9 seed had 2/1000 learned-empty predictions under the organized input operator.
Read-only live probe confirming width 16, height 350, point step 22, row step 352, velodyne frame and successful exact conversion to 16x720.

sampling.rule: Six predeclared independent closed-loop case units, two worlds by three checkpoint seeds, each exactly 180 simulated seconds after the first waypoint; retain every message from the AEE V2 recording contract.

teacher.source: No teacher or complete map enters the planner. Direction is V9, count is frozen current-scan B0, and role is fixed from count.
teacher.valid_mask: Every raw frame must pass the exact organized PointCloud2 layout/ring checks and the frozen 0.1-second scan-pose pairing bound.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Only current/past organized sensor observations and trace-verified traversals drive graph and waypoint decisions.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only AEE tunnel/garage development worlds and predeclared environment seed 11 are used.

method.main: V9 learned direction plus frozen B0 count and fixed role, followed by causal topology and deterministic frontier planning through unchanged local planning/control.
method.baseline: V1R2 is sealed interface-mismatch evidence and contributes no cases to V1R3.
method.necessary_fallback: B0 supplies direction only when V9 direction is empty; post-frame20 use must remain at most 5% per case.
method.interface_fix: For V9 only, decode original 16x350 /velodyne_points with the exact training operator and pair it to /state_estimation_at_scan under the already frozen 0.1-second bound. Registered scan remains coverage evidence. Legacy modes remain unchanged.

estimated_cost.compute: Six serial Gazebo/ROS CPU cases; 1080 simulation seconds; zero training or GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: Six raw organized-input bags, topic audits, scan-pose timing traces, trajectories, graph snapshots, decision traces, gate metrics, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Trajectory, graph and waypoint artifacts remain available per case; the formal decision is machine-gated.
evidence.failure_policy: Any interface, topic, timing, movement, graph, fallback or archive failure stops and seals V1R3. No retry, threshold change, model change, case deletion or C09/C10 read.

replacement_contract.only_change: Restore the exact organized raw LiDAR observation operator used during V9 training and record that raw input as formal evidence.
